headline: Everything new in v1.87.0: calmer UI, stronger agents, BAAM growth and headless Linux
feat1: Cohesive desktop polish: calmer panels, compact tool calls, cleaner find bars and toasts
feat2: Knowledge defaults: pick a model for ingestion while chats keep their active model
feat3: Agent Drafter: stronger app scaffolds, workflow planning and safety harnesses
feat4: Runtime hardening: steadier agent loop, sandbox, scheduler, providers and MCP surfaces
feat5: BAAM growth: Apache-2.0 skills plus .brxt extensions for scientific platforms
feat6: Headless Linux: run BioRouter from a Debian/Ubuntu server and open it in a browser
feat7: Release packaging: signed macOS builds, Linux GUI packages and CLI-only installs
feat8: UI reliability: responsive knowledge graphs, refined sidebars and safer update handling
